title: Drinking alcohol in public
question: Can I drink alcohol in a park or on the street in Poland?
short_answer: Generally prohibited in public spaces unless the municipality allows it.
conditions: Prohibited in most public spaces: streets, squares, parks, playgrounds
Some cities have designated areas where public drinking is permitted
Licensed outdoor cafes and beer gardens are exceptions
Warsaw, Kraków, and other cities have specific local regulations
exceptions: Licensed outdoor terraces and beer gardens
Designated alcohol consumption zones (strefy picia alkoholu)
Private events on enclosed private property
penalties: Fine: 100 PLN for drinking in a prohibited public space

sources.title: Ustawa o wychowaniu w trzeźwości – Sejm RP
